hub_no_apps_found: No Vox apps with export/import support found on this device.
hub_backup_config_shared_note: This selection is also what scheduled backups use — configure it once here.
hub_include_secrets_warning: Warning: apps with API keys on will keep including them in plain text in every export and scheduled backup, until turned off again. Keep exported files somewhere secure.
hub_import_partial_warning: This backup is incomplete — it was saved without: %1$s
hub_import_no_matching_apps: This file doesn't match any installed Vox app.
hub_import_invalid_file: Couldn't read that file as a Vox export.
hub_prewarm_message: %1$s haven't been opened yet (or were Force Stopped), so they didn't respond to the backup request. Let Hub open just those apps and retry, or save the backup with what already succeeded.
hub_prewarm_retry_message: %1$s still didn't respond after being opened. Try once more, or save a backup without them — the archive will record which apps are missing.
voxconnect_menu_desc: Pair a computer over Wi-Fi and choose which Vox apps it may reach
voxconnect_enable_desc: Lets a paired VoxConnect desktop app read and command monitored apps over your local WiFi network.
voxconnect_confirm_revoke_message: Remove "%s"? It will need to be paired again to reconnect.
voxconnect_media_control_desc: Lets a paired device see what's playing and control playback via Vox Commander.
voxconnect_scan_qr_hint: Point your camera at the QR code shown by VoxConnect on your computer.
voxconnect_pairing_failed: Couldn't reach that computer — check it's on the same network and try again.
voxconnect_camera_permission_denied: Camera permission is needed to scan the pairing code.
voxconnect_battery_warning: Battery optimization is on for Vox Hub — the bridge may stop responding while your screen is off.
voxconnect_media_permission_warning: Media control needs notification access for Vox Commander to see what's playing.
backup_schedule_menu_desc: Automatic backup frequency, how many to keep and the list of past backups
backup_schedule_uses_main_screen_config: Uses the Settings/Data/API keys/Attachments selection configured for each app on the main screen.
backup_schedule_nothing_selected: Nothing is selected on the main screen — scheduling is disabled until at least one app has something turned on.
backup_retention_unlimited_warning: Keeping unlimited backups uses more storage over time — nothing here ever deletes an old one automatically.
import_mode_desc: How every app reconciles an imported file against what's already on it. Still only touches apps with Data enabled above.
backup_partial_banner_title: Scheduled backup is missing some apps
logs_settings_menu_desc: Debug logging and the captured log, to read, copy or share
backup_restore_menu_desc: Save Hub's own settings to a file, or restore them
debug_logging_desc: Write debug info to logcat — leave off unless you're troubleshooting an issue
sync_waiting_for_tap: Hold this phone near the other device…
sync_resolving_bluetooth: Finding the other device over Bluetooth…
sync_bluetooth_not_found: Paired, but couldn't find the device over Bluetooth. It will retry the next time you sync.
sync_permission_required: Bluetooth permission is needed to pair devices
sync_scope_no_categories: No categories found for this app
import_mode_caveat_merge: Safest: restores the file and deletes only records that existed when it was exported — anything created on this device afterwards is kept.
import_mode_caveat_full_override: DELETES everything in the enabled apps — including records created AFTER the backup — then restores only what the file contains.
import_mode_caveat_additive: Never deletes anything — importing the same file again DUPLICATES its records.
